# Pine grove illustration

Generated using the built-in image generation tool, with a transparent background. The resulting PNG is bundled locally as `pine-grove.png` and composited into the Canvas artwork. Preserve the original alpha channel.

## Final prompt

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent illustrated foreground asset for a Japanese art poster. Create exactly THREE beautiful mature Japanese black pine trees together as a balanced asymmetrical grove. Entire trees from roots to crown are visible. Tallest tree on the left, a medium tree at center, and a smaller tree on the right and slightly farther back. Three distinguishable gracefully curved, tapered trunks, natural branching, irregular dense feathery masses of fine pine needles, rich negative space between branches. Elegant windswept Japanese woodblock botanical illustration with a contemporary restrained print finish. Sophisticated natural tree anatomy, strong silhouettes, nuanced carved texture. Use ONLY deep muted indigo ink (approximately #1d324b) and subtle slate blue (approximately #425873), with the farthest tree lighter for depth. Do not use green. Composition: compact triangular grove, approximately square, generous transparent margin around all tips, tree roots on one consistent ground level. Fully transparent background with genuine alpha; no sky, no mountain, no sun, no birds, no rocks, no text, no frame, no paper rectangle, no drop shadow. Avoid flat horizontal shelves, cartoon cloud lobes, broccoli shapes, radial fireworks, grass-like sparse needles, straight poles, repeated identical trees, and disconnected branches. This must be a beautifully observed illustration of pines rather than a geometric tree symbol.
